name: io.github.hyeonsang010716/opendockit
title: OpenDocKit
description: Read local PDF, Office, HWP, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, HTML and email files as Markdown. Offline.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A folder the server may read (repeatable). Without it, any file the user can read.

environmentVariables.name: OPENDOCKIT_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the server may read, separated like PATH. Without it, any file the user can read.
